decision: All estimated full-round scenarios exceed 0.20; request approval before paid execution.

price_basis.note: No assumption of off-peak, prompt-cache discounts or free credits. API bill may be lower; persistent ledger uses conservative peak list prices.

cache_preflight.rerank_note: Zero matching question payloads proves no existing batch can match exact key; future batch content depends on unpaid planner/retrieval and is not invented.
cache_preflight.query_embedding_cache: Unknown until planner produces search queries; document vectors reused, query allowance included.
cache_preflight.generation_cache: Current runner has no cross-round generation cache; existing run receipts only resume an identical manifest.

basis.basis: conservative peak list cost, no cache discounts/free credits; not an invoice

limitations: Estimates are not exact invoices or a hard worst-case bound.
Four disclosure-only cases can still retrieve/rerank in the current planner; lean/central omit those downstream costs.
No true pipeline tuning or reranker substitution to reduce this baseline cost.
Default cumulative stop is already below committed historic cost; if approved, use an explicit experiment override in the same ledger, never reset prior spend.
A 0.20 batch cap would stop this likely over-budget run early; that would be a partial attempt, not a 41-case result.
